ticket_machine.name: Validated Parking
ticket_machine.desc: An attendant's booth near the Exit Sign has a ticket machine with eighteen level buttons. Three damaged tickets lie around it, each with a symbol, a number and a time. They read like instructions.

obj.label: Enter the symbols into the machine

drowned_bracelet.name: Still Receiving
drowned_bracelet.desc: Something at the Flooded Bay is guarding a body, not treasure. The bracelet on its wrist is still getting Network notifications.

obj.label: Read the bracelet at the Flooded Bay
